risk_description:
The bolt of the pressure-input shaft situated between the electromechanical brake servo and the brake pedal may come loose.
As a result, the mechanical connection between the brake pedal and the
brake servo would no longer be guaranteed, increasing the risk of an
accident.
In the event of an emergency, the vehicle can be immobilised by activating the electronic parking brake.
legal_provision: The product does not meet the requirements set out in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles
